lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Nine neck-bells. Nine names. One great bell to call the herd home.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Varkas came in the blue hour. By dawn the birthing pen was black-red, and our bells hung from his killers.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Maren pushed me beneath the ice trough before his knife found her. Ten winters later, I have come back with her carbine.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Cross three scars of this mountain. Take every name. Ring the mother bell. Put Varkas in the ground.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Asha taught me to step where the needles were thick. Her killer wore her bell to warn the others when he fed.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Rowan mended every broken strap in the fold. I have to cut his bell free. The leather has grown into the rust.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Tember built the ice trough. He made it deep enough for a winter's water. Deep enough to hide one child.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Lissa could name a missing goat by the silence in the herd. Four bells answer now. The mother bell will hear us.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Hollin hauled the abbey's first stones. His bell is dented flat on one side. I turn that side into my palm.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Brae stitched Maren's wounds after the rockfall. There was nobody left to stitch hers. I wipe the bell on my coat.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Sorrel kept seed beneath the hearth through every lean winter. The hearth is cold. I keep the bell warm in my hand.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Maren put her hand over my mouth beneath the trough. Stay quiet, she said. I carried her carbine here. I carry her name out.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Orin was small enough to sleep against my ribs. Varkas wore his bell through ten winters. He will not wear it through another dawn.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: The pines kept the smell for ten winters: sap, cold iron, and the blood they could not bury.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: They sleep inside our fence. Four of our bells knock against their armour when they breathe.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: The snow thins here. Bone shows through the old red earth. Four names will wake the mother bell.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: The bell has given the dead a voice. I carry it uphill, one shot at a time.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Eight names open the abbey our herd built. The ninth still knocks against Varkas' throat. Orin. My little brother.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: The mother bell tears the silence open. Every wolverine looks uphill. Every stolen bell answers.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Varkas lowers his plated head. Orin's bell knocks once against his throat.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: His hide splits under the iron. Four memorial lamps spit red; he howls, and the last of the pack comes running.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: The plates tear free. Eight names burn around him. He lowers the red horn; I remember Maren's hand. Be still. Let him commit. Then move.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Varkas dies beneath the bell he stole from Orin. I leave his iron in the mud.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: I do not wear the nine bells as trophies. I carry them down through ash, bone, and snow.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: At dawn the mother bell calls them home: Asha. Rowan. Tember. Lissa. Hollin. Brae. Sorrel. Maren. Orin.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: The mountain remembers. This time, it speaks our names instead of his.

lines.speaker: varkas
lines.text: Another goat, climbing my mountain.

lines.speaker: varkas
lines.text: The bells told me you were coming.

lines.speaker: varkas
lines.text: I wear their names. Take one, if you can.

lines.speaker: varkas
lines.text: Pack! Tear it down!

lines.speaker: varkas
lines.text: Come, then. Meet the horn.

lines.speaker: varkas
lines.text: Is that all the herd left?

lines.speaker: varkas
lines.text: Down you go, with the rest.

lines.speaker: varkas
lines.text: Ring it, then. I hear them anyway.

lines.speaker: pack_a
lines.text: Contact! Contact!

lines.speaker: pack_a
lines.text: Lost him.

lines.speaker: varkas
lines.text: The mountain keeps the goat.

lines.speaker: pack_b
lines.text: There he is!

lines.speaker: pack_b
lines.text: Where did he go?

lines.speaker: pack_a
lines.text: Flank him!

lines.speaker: pack_b
lines.text: Go around!

lines.speaker: pack_a
lines.text: Body! Someone's here!

lines.speaker: pack_b
lines.text: Someone killed him. Find them.
